evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: if the annual contract employee has received two (2) consecutive annual evaluation performance ratings of unsatisfactory, two (2) annual performance evaluation ratings of unsatisfactory within a three-year period, or three (3) consecutive annual performance ratings of needs improvement or a combination of needs improvement and unsatisfactory, notwithstanding Article I Section G of this Agreement the District will non-reappoint the employee and will not offer that employee another annual contract.
